rejected_rule.statement: The doctrine of priority by registration is inapplicable when two deeds form part of one transaction and are contemporaneously executed, each deed must speak only as part of the one transaction.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Hence I hold that the doctrine of priority by registration is inapplicable in this instance. Where several deeds form part of one transaction and are contemporaneously executed, each deed must speak only as part of the one transaction.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 7(4) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance
